lines.text: A bare round hall. The circle is drawn on its floor at the Hollow's scale, and every wall is lined with identical forms.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: A causeway of pale slabs runs out over a pit of mist. Six lamps stand along it, paired like folded legs.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: At the foot of the gate, a postmark is torn into the stone. Half of it is his.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre
warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
FILED
The ring around the circle becomes a line of writing, then a door number. Slice writes it with her scalpel, one stroke at a time.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre
warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: It lands on leather. A wallet hits the grass and rolls, and the circle's ring lights around him.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
NO FIXED ADDRESS
Past the last lantern the Hollow runs out. Far off, a gate stands in the dark with nothing written on it.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre
warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: One number. One door, for the circle.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Out of the dark comes a stamp: RETURN TO SENDER. Its ink is the only bright thing in the Hollow.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Past the broken gate the ground drops away into a yard lit by lamps. Rows of Yo Bot chassis hang on hooks.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Past the last lantern the Hollow runs out. Far off, a gate stands in the dark with nothing written on it.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
SERVED
Out on the slabs a Spider Bot stops a step short of the lamps, folds one leg, and offers a paper on the tip of its claw, politely, the way a courier would. Slice does not take it. It waits.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
SERVED
The Server comes down the last slabs and stops a step short of the lamps. It folds one leg and offers a paper on the tip of its claw.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Six deliveries' worth of bolts lie in the grass, warm as coins.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text:
SIX LOST THINGS
A postcard. A key. A hat. A paper. A page. A stamp. Wallit sets them down in the ring, one at a time.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre
warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre

lines.text: Slice takes her scalpel and begins on the door number, one stroke at a time.
lines.direction: warm, even, storybook narrator; slow and sombre
